procedure: Create one disposable validation environment containing only the repository-declared .[dev] extra, then create a second disposable render environment containing separately authorized CairoSVG==2.8.2 and its transitive dependencies.
expected_result: Validation uses only declared development dependencies; rendering uses only the separately authorized pinned renderer; no repository dependency declaration is changed.

authorized_render_environment.purpose: Rasterize and inspect the four committed Stage 3 SVG diagrams only

limitations: Local validation used Python 3.12; repository CI independently validates the supported Python 3.11 configuration.
Package resolution for the repository-declared development extra follows existing lower bounds and is not a lock-file claim.
The renderer environment is disposable, is not part of project dependencies, and authorizes no runtime use.
